description: Public recruiter-facing demo: NL prompt -> structured filters over a synthetic Irish property dataset. Static, GitHub Pages, no secrets. See plans/house-hunter-demo-spec.md.

tasks.task: Scaffold Vite + React + TS + Tailwind v4 + Zustand project
Define shared types in src/lib/types.ts (DemoListing, DemoFilters, ParseResult)
Verify zero secrets/env vars and no forbidden deps (react-router, better-auth, drizzle-orm)
Build scripts/generate-dataset.ts (seeded, reproducible) producing ~300 synthetic listings
Cover all 26 counties with plausible per-county price/BER/eircode distributions
Exclude private-only fields (score, tier, dan_verdict, drive_min, reno_*, all_in_*, tags, url)
Commit generated src/data/listings.json
Build src/lib/parse.ts: deterministic prompt -> {filters, spans}
Cover richer attribute patterns (outbuilding, pod_space, fibre, price_drop) plus county/price/beds/type/BER
Build src/lib/search.ts: pure filter/sort over listings.json
Write src/data/examples.ts curated prompts
tasks.note: 8 prompts, 6-25 results each; no town-scoped example — towns hold 1-4 listings so none can clear the >=5 floor

tasks.task: Add npm run validate-examples asserting every example returns >=5 results
tasks.note: also wired into npm run generate-data, which prints 'all examples validated'

tasks.task: Add Vitest + unit tests for parse and search (115 tests)
Prompt box + example chips + parse-breakdown highlight view
tasks.note: connectors are measured from the live DOM (SVG beziers phrase -> chip), redrawn on resize

tasks.task: Editable/removable filter chip rail wired to Zustand store
Results grid with BER chip, attribute badges, Leaflet/OSM mini-map
